title: ItemCheck
description: A convenient way for you to track which items you have collected.
body:
Building a mega warehouse and need to keep track of which items you have already collected? Then this mod is for you.

How to use:
- Press `O` to open the GUI
- Add or edit (RMB) tabs, which act as an item filter, showing you the items you want to see.
- Click and drag items to reorder them
- Right click an item to mark it as collected

Currently only tested for SinglePlayer (it stores data in World Server). That's because I prefer having 2 clients open. I will make it dedicated server compatible sometime soon.
